cards.name: Eclipse Observer Seara

effects.lua_implementation: EnableReviveLimit and aux.AddSynchroProcedure(c,nil,aux.NonTuner(nil),1) implement one unrestricted Tuner plus one or more non-Tuners.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses the identical generic aux.AddSynchroProcedure(c,nil,aux.NonTuner(nil),1) and EnableReviveLimit registration.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can return all Spell/Trap Cards your opponent controls to the hand. If your opponent has 6 or more cards in their hand, they cannot activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. You can only use this effect of Eclipse Observer Seara once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The delayed summon trigger checks SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO, enumerates every opponent on-field Spell/Trap able to return, and sends the group to hand. At six or more opponent hand cards, Duel.SetChainLimit permits only the controller to respond. SetCountLimit(1,id) is the hard once-per-turn code.

official_references.matched_structure: Enumerates on-field Spell/Traps with Card.IsAbleToHand and resolves the whole group through Duel.SendtoHand.
Uses Duel.SetChainLimit during targeting to suppress responses to an activation; Seara narrows the allowed responder to its controller.

effects.printed_clause: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, then your opponent draws 2 cards. You can only use this effect of Eclipse Observer Seara once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_CHAINING requires an opponent Spell/Trap card activation and a negatable chain, verifies the mandatory two-card draw is legal, then negates, destroys, and only after successful destruction draws two. SetCountLimit(1,id+100) is distinct from the other effects.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses the same CATEGORY_NEGATE+CATEGORY_DESTROY+CATEGORY_DRAW chain response, mandatory opponent draw legality, NegateActivation, destruction, and opponent draw sequence.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is sent to the GY: You can Set up to 2 Eclipse Quick-Play Spells from your GY or banishment. You can only use this effect of Eclipse Observer Seara once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_TO_GRAVE selects one or two settable Eclipse-named Quick-Play Spells from GY/face-up banishment, respects Necrovalley and available Spell/Trap Zones, and Sets them. The audit fixed the official-name pool to include both Book of Eclipse (35480699) and Book of Lunar Eclipse (31834488), in addition to the generated CCG Eclipse setcode. SetCountLimit(1,id+200) is distinct.

official_references.matched_structure: Selects a named Normal/Quick-Play Spell from Deck, GY, or face-up banishment with Necrovalley filtering and Sets it through Duel.SSet.

effects.issue: Confirmed pool defect: the prior Lua explicitly included Book of Eclipse but omitted the equally name-matching official Quick-Play Spell Book of Lunar Eclipse. Corrected by adding official ID 31834488 to the filter and listed names.

cards.audit_note: Adversarial review confirmed the Synchro procedure, conditional chain limit, Spell/Trap activation negation sequence, and GY/face-up-banishment Set pool. No engine or ruling limitation remains.
